level_one.title: Enduring Swarm
level_one.description: Dark Swarm's duration is increased by 0.5 seconds and grants 50 Spell Armor while active.

level_four.title: Hero Stalker
level_four.description: Increases Essence gained from Takedowns by 100%, and gain 1 Essence each time an enemy Hero is hit by Dark Swarm.

level_seven.title: Symbiosis
level_seven.description: Every time Dark Swarm damages an enemy Hero, reduce its cooldown by 0.4 seconds.

level_ten.title: Isolation
level_ten.description: Launch biomass that hits the first enemy Hero dealing 200 (+4% per level) damage, revealing, Silencing, and Slowing them 30% for 3 seconds. Additionally, their vision radius is greatly reduced for 6 seconds.

level_thirteen.title: Primal Swarm
level_thirteen.description: Dark Swarm causes enemies hit to lose 10 Armor for 0.75 seconds, causing them to take 10% extra damage.

level_one.title: Swift Sweep
level_one.description: Increases the cast speed of Sacred Sweep by 50%.

level_four.title: Majestic Span
level_four.description: Increases the radius of Sacred Sweep by 15%.

level_seven.title: Energized Cord
level_seven.description: Increases the energy stored from Auriel's Basic Attacks to 120% of the damage against Heroes and 55% of the damage against non-Heroes.  Does not affect Auriel's Bestow Hope ally.

level_ten.title: Crystal Aegis
level_ten.description: Place an allied Hero into Stasis for 2 seconds. Upon expiration, Crystal Aegis deals 255 (+4% per level) damage to all nearby enemies.

level_thirteen.title: Blinding Flash
level_thirteen.description: Enemies hit by the center area of Sacred Sweep are blinded for 2 seconds.

level_sixteen.title: Reservoir of Hope
level_sixteen.description: Quest: Each maximum energy Ray of Heaven Auriel casts increases the maximum amount of energy that can be stored by 75.

level_one.title: Warbreaker
level_one.description: Quest: Stun Heroes with Groundbreaker.  Reward: After Stunning 5 Heroes, Groundbreaker's Stun deals an additional 165 (+4% per level) damage over 3 seconds to Heroes.  Reward: After Stunning 15 Heroes, permanently reduce Groundbreaker's cooldown by 2 seconds.

level_four.title: Thirst for Battle
level_four.description: Basic Attacks against Heroes reduce the cooldown of Bloodthirst by 2 seconds.

level_seven.title: Oppressor
level_seven.description: Basic Attacks and Bloodthirst against Heroes reduce the target's Spell Power by 30% for 2.5 seconds.

level_ten.title: Warlord's Challenge
level_ten.description: Silence nearby Heroes and force them to attack Garrosh for 2 seconds.

level_thirteen.title: Defensive Measures
level_thirteen.description: If Groundbreaker Stuns a Hero, Garrosh gains a 350 (+4% per level) Shield for 6 seconds.

level_sixteen.title: Mortal Combo
level_sixteen.description: Hitting a Hero with Groundbreaker's Stun and throwing them with Wrecking Ball within 3 seconds reduces Wrecking Ball's cooldown by 10 seconds, regardless of order.

level_one.title: Maximum Charge
level_one.description: Regen Globes now instantly grant 20 Energy.  Quest: Spend 150 seconds at or above 50 Energy.  Reward: Gain an additional 20 maximum Energy.

level_four.title: Speed Barrier
level_four.description: Shield Ally increases the allied Hero's Movement Speed by 50% for the duration.

level_seven.title: Pinpoint Accuracy
level_seven.description: Particle Grenade deals 30 (+4% per level) more damage and Slows Movement Speed by 25% for 2 seconds to enemies hit by the center of the blast.

level_ten.title: Expulsion Zone
level_ten.description: Launch a gravity bomb that deals 124 (+4% per level) damage and creates an expulsion zone for 3.5 seconds. Enemies who enter the affected area are knocked back and have their Movement Speed reduced by 50% for 1 second.

level_thirteen.title: Unstoppable Competitor
level_thirteen.description: Personal Barrier makes Zarya Unstoppable for up to 2 seconds.

level_sixteen.title: Cleansing Shield
level_sixteen.description: Causes Shield Ally to remove all disabling effects and reduces its cooldown by 3 seconds.

level_one.title: Hot Pursuit
level_one.description: Increase the Movement Speed bonus of each stack of Hatred to 2%.

level_four.title: Punishment
level_four.description: While at max Hatred, Multishot's cooldown recharges 50% faster.

level_seven.title: Arsenal
level_seven.description: Increase the range of Multishot by 20%. Multishot also fires 3 grenades that deal 100 (+4% per level) damage and refund 25 Mana after hitting enemy Heroes.

level_ten.title: Rain of Vengeance
level_ten.description: Launch a wave of Shadow Beasts that deals 250 (+4% per level) damage and Stuns enemies in the target area for 0.5 seconds.  Stores up to 2 charges.

level_thirteen.title: Gloom
level_thirteen.description: Activate to consume all Hatred, granting 3 Spell Armor per Hatred consumed for 5 seconds.  Passive: Gain 15 Spell Armor, and each stack of Hatred heals for 1.2 (+4% per level) Health per second.

level_sixteen.title: Manticore
level_sixteen.description: Every 3rd Basic Attack against the same Hero deals an additional 5% of their maximum Health as damage.

level_one.title: Field Study
level_one.description: Each enemy Hero hit by Scroll of Sealing grants 20% Spell Power for 16 seconds, up to 40%.

level_four.title: Ruby
level_four.description: Activate to increase the damage of the next Horadric Cube by 100%  and it spawns 3 Lesser Healing Potions from each enemy Hero hit, healing allied Heroes for 250 (+4% per level) when picked up. Lesser Healing Potions last for 10 seconds.  Only 1 Gem may be active at a time.

level_seven.title: Kanai's Cube
level_seven.description: Horadric Cube reduces Hero damage dealt by 30% for 4 seconds.

level_ten.title: Stay Awhile and Listen
level_ten.description: After 1 second, Channel for 3 seconds, putting enemy Heroes in front of Deckard to Sleep while Channeling, and for 2 seconds after.  Enemies can only be put to Sleep once per cast, and Sleep's effects end instantly if they take damage.

level_thirteen.title: Ancient Blessings
level_thirteen.description: Activate Fortitude of the Faithful to empower nearby allied Hero Basic Attacks for 8 seconds, causing them to deal an additional 62 (+4% per level) damage in an area and heal for 90 (+4% per level) for each Hero hit. This effect can only occur once per second.

level_sixteen.title: Scroll of Stone Curse
level_sixteen.description: Scroll of Sealing deals 200% more damage when hitting at least 2 Heroes.

level_twenty.title: Perfect Gems
level_twenty.description: Reduce the cooldown of all Gems to 5 seconds and the cooldown of Horadric Cube by 6 seconds.

level_four.title: Pursuit of Justice
level_four.description: Hammer of Justice increases Uther's Movement Speed by 25% for 3 seconds.

level_seven.title: Hand of Protection
level_seven.description: Activate to make target ally Unstoppable for 1 second. Cannot be cast on Uther. Basic Attacks reduce Hand of Protection's cooldown by 5 seconds.

level_ten.title: Divine Shield
level_ten.description: Make an allied Hero Invulnerable and increase their Movement Speed by 20% for 3 seconds.

level_thirteen.title: Well Met
level_thirteen.description: When used against Heroes, Hammer of Justice reduces the target's Movement Speed and damage dealt by 25% for 3 seconds.

level_sixteen.title: Benediction
level_sixteen.description: Activate to reduce the Mana cost of Uther's next Basic Ability by 50 and its cooldown by 10 seconds.

level_one.title: Swift as the Wind
level_one.description: Hitting an enemy Hero with Swift Strike increases Genji's Movement Speed by 30% for 3 seconds.

level_four.title: Strike At The Heart
level_four.description: Enemies hit by the end of Swift Strike take an additional 134 (+4% per level) damage after 1 second.

level_seven.title: Perfect Defense
level_seven.description: Deflected damage reduces the cooldown of Deflect by 2 seconds, up to a maximum of 10 seconds.

level_ten.title: Dragonblade
level_ten.description: Unleash the Dragonblade for 8 seconds. While active, Dragonblade can be reactivated to lunge forward and slash in a huge arc, dealing 240 (+4% per level) damage.

level_thirteen.title: Shingan
level_thirteen.description: Hitting an enemy with all 3 Shuriken deals 115 (+4% per level) bonus damage.

level_sixteen.title: Final Cut
level_sixteen.description: After 1 second, Swift Strike deals an additional 125 (+4% per level) damage to all enemies in the area.

level_one.title: Static Charge
level_one.description: Quest: Heroes hit by Shock Ray permanently increases its damage by 5 and grants 33% Resonance Beam charge.  Maximum of 200 bonus damage.

level_four.title: Plasma Shield
level_four.description: While Resonance Beam is fully charged, gain a Shield equal to 3% of max Health every second, stacking up to 12%.

level_seven.title: Psionic Echo
level_seven.description: Casting Psionic Storm causes your next Shock Ray within 3 seconds to only cost 30 Mana and create a Psionic Storm on the first enemy Hero hit.

level_ten.title: Archon
level_ten.description: Tassadar transforms into an Archon, gaining a Shield equal to 25% of his maximum Health and empowering Resonance Beam. Lasts for 12 seconds.  Resonance Beam: Deals 140 (+4% per level) damage to the target and splashes 70 (+4% per level) damage to nearby enemies. Heroes hit have their Spell Armor reduced by 20 for 2 seconds. Resonance Beam is fully charged while Archon is active.

level_thirteen.title: Oracle
level_thirteen.description: Passive: While stationary, gain 30 Spell Armor for 0.75 seconds and restore 12 (+4% per level) Health a second.  Activate to Channel for up to 4 seconds, revealing a gradually increasing area anywhere on the map.

level_sixteen.title: Thermal Lance
level_sixteen.description: Shock Ray deals an additional 8% of maximum Health as damage to the first Hero it hits.

level_twenty.title: Twilight Archon
level_twenty.description: Basic Attacks while in Archon form increase its duration by 2 seconds.

level_one.title: Furious Blow
level_one.description: Every 4th cast of Seismic Slam deals 40% more damage to the primary target and costs no Fury.

level_four.title: Shattered Ground
level_four.description: Increase Seismic Slam's splash damage by 250%. Targeting a Hero with Seismic Slam further increases its splash damage by 250%, while targeting other enemies increases the length of its splash by 66%.

level_seven.title: Poisoned Spear
level_seven.description: Ancient Spear deals an additional 100% damage over 6 seconds.

level_ten.title: Wrath of the Berserker
level_ten.description: Increase damage dealt by 40%. Reduce the duration of Stuns, Roots, and Slows against Sonya by 50%. Lasts 15 seconds, and extends by 1 second for every 10 Fury gained.

level_thirteen.title: No Escape
level_thirteen.description: Increases the Movement Speed bonus from using Basic and Heroic Abilities to 20%.

level_sixteen.title: Nerves of Steel
level_sixteen.description: Activate to gain 25% of your maximum Health as a Shield for 3 seconds. Usable while Whirlwinding.
